# LogPilot

Go application for evidence-based log diagnosis using CloudWeGo Eino.

## Read first

- `README.md`: setup, architecture, configuration, and API overview.
- `docs/design/01-软件需求规格说明书.md`: normative requirements.
- `docs/design/02-概要设计说明书.md`: architecture and boundaries.
- `docs/design/openapi.yaml`: HTTP contract.
- `docs/plans/2026-09-29-logpilot-mvp.md`: implementation history.

## Constraints

- Never commit API keys.
- Do not add shell execution or arbitrary URL tools.
- Keep Agent MaxStep at 6 and diagnosis timeout at 60 seconds.
- Define interfaces at consuming packages and wire dependencies in `cmd/server`.
